Income Tax Return Filing for Individuals Facing Income Tax Notice – Expert Guidance by IGSK & Associates

Filing your Income Tax Return (ITR) is not just a yearly compliance—it is a critical financial responsibility that ensures transparency, avoids penalties, and keeps you aligned with tax laws. However, many individuals face a stressful situation when they receive an Income Tax Notice from the department. If you are someone who has received such a notice, it is important to act promptly and correctly.

At IGSK & Associates, Chartered Accountants, we specialize in Income Tax Return filing for individuals, especially in cases where income tax notices have been issued. Our expert team ensures proper compliance, accurate filing, and professional representation to resolve your case smoothly.

Understanding Income Tax Notices

An Income Tax Notice is issued by the Income Tax Department when there is a discrepancy, mismatch, or missing information in your tax return or financial records. Many individuals panic upon receiving such notices, but the truth is—most notices can be resolved easily with the right professional guidance.

Common reasons for receiving an Income Tax Notice include:

Non-filing of Income Tax Return
Mismatch between Form 26AS and reported income
High-value transactions not disclosed
Incorrect deduction claims
TDS/TCS mismatch
Income discrepancies from stock market or other investments

Ignoring such notices can lead to penalties, interest, or even legal issues

Income Tax Return Filing for Individuals – Essential for TDS on Cash Withdrawal Compliance

In today’s evolving tax environment, Income Tax Return (ITR) filing is no longer just a yearly compliance—it has become a crucial financial document for individuals, especially when dealing with banking transactions such as cash withdrawals where Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) is applicable.

At IGSK & Associates, Chartered Accountants, we provide expert guidance and professional support for accurate and timely Income Tax Return filing, ensuring that our clients not only remain compliant but also avoid unnecessary tax deductions and notices.

Understanding TDS on Cash Withdrawal

Many individuals are unaware that banks are required to deduct TDS on cash withdrawals under certain conditions as per the Income Tax Act. If a person withdraws cash exceeding specified limits during a financial year, banks may deduct TDS under Section 194N.

When does TDS apply on cash withdrawals?
If cash withdrawals exceed ₹20 lakh in a financial year (for non-filers of ITR for last 3 years)
If withdrawals exceed ₹1 crore (for regular ITR filers)

In such cases, banks deduct TDS ranging from 2% to 5%, depending on the situation.Verification of ITR Filing Status

Avoid Higher TDS Deduction

Income Tax Return Filing for Visa Application – Complete Guidance by IGSK & Associates, Chartered Accountants

If you are planning to travel abroad for work, business, study, or tourism, one of the most important documents required for your visa process is your Income Tax Return (ITR). Many embassies and immigration authorities consider ITR as a crucial financial proof to assess your credibility, income stability, and intention to return to your home country.

At IGSK & Associates, Chartered Accountants, we provide expert assistance in Income Tax Return filing for visa applications, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and strong documentation to improve your chances of visa approval.

Why is Income Tax Return Important for Visa Application?

Income Tax Return is not just a compliance requirement in India, but it also acts as a financial identity document when applying for a visa. Most countries such as the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and Schengen countries require ITR for:

Proof of income and financial stability
Evidence of lawful earnings
Verification of tax compliance
Supporting document for bank statements
Establishing strong ties with India

Embassies generally ask for last 2 to 3 years ITR copies, especially for business owners, professionals, and high-income individuals.

Who Needs ITR for Visa Application?

Filing Income Tax Return becomes essential for:

Salaried individuals applying for tourist or work visa
Business owners and self-employed professionals
Freelancers

📌 Income Tax Return Filing for Individuals – Claim Your TDS Refund Easily

At IGSK & Associates, we specialize in Income Tax Return (ITR) filing for individuals, ensuring that you not only remain compliant with tax laws but also maximize your refund from TDS (Tax Deducted at Source).

If you are a salaried employee, freelancer, or investor, there is a high possibility that excess TDS has been deducted from your income. Filing your Income Tax Return correctly is the only way to claim your rightful refund from the Income Tax Department.

🔍 What is TDS and Why Refund Arises?

TDS (Tax Deducted at Source) is deducted by employers, banks, or other payers before making payments to you. However, in many cases:

Your total income falls below taxable limits
You are eligible for deductions under various sections
Excess TDS is deducted due to incorrect declarations
Bank interest or other incomes attract higher TDS

This results in extra tax being paid, which can be claimed back only through proper ITR filing.

✅ Who Should File ITR for TDS Refund?

You should definitely file your Income Tax Return if:

TDS is deducted from your salary or bank interest
You have Form 16 or Form 16A showing deductions
You have investments eligible for deductions
Your income is below taxable limits but TDS is deducted
You want to carry forward losses (stocks, mutual funds, etc.)
You want to avoid notices from the Income Tax Department

Even if your income is not taxable, filing ITR is essential
